talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.blossom_night: Leave something at the water's edge before you swim. A melon rind will do. Don't ask me who for.
The paddy by the river was a row short this morning. We don't set a watch. We set out a dish.
If a woman asks you the way on a snowy night, you have a fire to get back to. Say so and go to it.
My grandfather met someone in white on the pass one winter. He kept a torch lit in every room till he died.
Bury them. I don't care whose they were. A field left like that does not stay quiet.
After the fighting at the ford they left the dead a week. Nobody farms the ford now.
No captain out of here sails without an empty barrel on deck. It isn't for water.
In fog, at night, if the sea goes smooth and black ahead: give it the barrel. Don't shoot at it.
We hold the lantern feast at the full moon for a reason. Nothing walks then.
Count the days to the dark of the moon and be indoors for it. Two come where one came before.
My grandfather's net came up off the cape with a roof tile in it. Green stone, cut square. He threw it back and so would you.
On a flat calm you can see lamps under the deep water, a long way down. The boats do not anchor there.
